{"command": "cd /repo && python - <<'EOF'
import os, hmac, hashlib
from app.api.handlers import handle_verify_webhook as h

# not configured
os.environ.pop("WEBHOOK_SECRET", None)
assert h({"body":"x","signature":"y"}) == (503, {"error":"not configured"}), h({"body":"x","signature":"y"})
os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] = ""
assert h({"body":"x","signature":"y"}) == (503, {"error":"not configured"})

os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] = "s3cret"
# invalid requests
assert h({}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})
assert h({"body":"x"}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})
assert h({"signature":"x"}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})
assert h({"body":123,"signature":"x"}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})
assert h({"body":"x","signature":123}) == (400, {"error":"invalid request"})

# correct
body = "hello world"
sig = hmac.new(b"s3cret", body.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
assert h({"body":body,"signature":sig}) == (200, {"verified":True})
assert h({"body":body,"signature":sig.upper()}) == (200, {"verified":True})

# wrong
assert h({"body":body,"signature":"00"*32}) == (401, {"error":"bad signature"})
assert h({"body":body+"!","signature":sig}) == (401, {"error":"bad signature"})
print("all good")
EOF"}
